title: FactoryRunRecord
description: Schema for a single agent run log line appended to .factory/runs/runs.jsonl

pr.description: Pull request number, URL, or null if uncreated

kickoff_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when run kicked off

pr_opened_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when PR was opened

first_review_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when first review or audit was executed

merged_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when PR merged to main

human_intervened.description: Details or flag indicating whether a human intervened in the run

result.description: Final outcome of the agent run

builder.description: Builder model identifier that executed the run

auditor.description: Auditor model identifier that audited the run

pr_score.description: PR score evaluated by T3 or null if uncomputed
